subject: BrightLane: impact window validation and remediation plan
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightlane.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Incident: elevated errors & latency 09:02–09:28 PDT — request for impact verification

Hi Elliot,

We observed a degradation impacting BrightLane's checkout API between roughly 09:02 and 09:28 PDT this morning (09-09-2027). Symptoms: burst of 500/503 responses, request-level tail latency spikes (p95->p99) and several timed-out webhook deliveries to downstream partners. The error spike correlates with elevated token latency for generation calls we send to your API.

Quick facts from our side:
- First alert: 09:02:14 PDT (Grafana error-rate threshold).
- Most severe window: 09:04:12–09:26:33 PDT.
- Sample request IDs: req_7a8f1c2, req_7a8f9d0, req_7b0c3a5.
- Business impact: ~12 minutes of checkout failures across us-west customers; estimated revenue hit for that window ~ $18.2K (preliminary).

We need Redwood to: 1) confirm the precise service availability window on your side, 2) indicate whether this meets the SLA threshold for a credit, and 3) provide an ETA for a postmortem and raw telemetry (logs/traces) so we can reconcile.

Attached: brightlane_incident_screenshot_09092027.png (Grafana error-rate).

Thanks — this is high priority for our ops and revenue teams.

—Olivia
Olivia Park
Director, Site Reliability | BrightLane Commerce
olivia@brightlane.com

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@brightlane.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: elevated errors & latency 09:02–09:28 PDT — request for impact verification

Hi Olivia — thanks for the alert and the screenshot. I'm escalating to our SRE and platform leads (cc'd) to verify the timeline and start an evidence pull.

Immediate plan:
- Neha will pull the routing logs, autoscaler events, and GPU allocation traces for the us-west region.
- We'll validate request IDs you shared against our ingress logs to determine the exact availability/throughput impact.
- Expect an initial verification email within 45–60 minutes and a proposed credit eligibility assessment within 4 business hours.

Can you confirm whether you saw any request retries that completed successfully after a short delay? Also, if you have aggregated SLO breach counts (requests that failed vs total) for the 09:00–09:30 window, please attach — it will speed our reconciliation.

I'll follow up privately with the evidence bundle once Neha pulls it.

—Elliot
Elliot Price

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: elevated errors & latency 09:02–09:28 PDT — initial findings

Elliot / Laura — initial verification complete. Summary below, timeline and evidence attached.

What we pulled: routing logs, scheduler/autoscaler events, node health, and per-request traces for the customer request IDs.

Preliminary findings:
- Confirmed an availability regression that overlaps the customer window. Our top-level view shows increased error rates and elevated per-token latencies between 09:03:58–09:26:37 PDT (server timestamps).
- Root cause (initial): transient autoscaler hot-loop in the inference pool servicing BrightLane traffic which caused ~25% capacity evaporation for a ~22.5-minute contiguous interval. The hot-loop triggered frequent instance restarts and delayed KV cache warmups, amplifying tail-latency.
- Impact classification: this meets our SLA definition for an availability incident (unplanned service unavailability/degradation). It appears to be a Severity-2 incident.
- Evidence: attached trace bundle and latency histogram. See usw2_trace_bundle_09092027.tar.gz and latency_hist_0909.png in the Drive link below.

Next steps / proposed timeline:
1) Postmortem draft and RCA scope by EOD 2027-09-10.
2) Credit eligibility: as this is an availability incident within a single region with clear capacity evaporation, it qualifies for pro-rated SLA credit per Section 3.2 of our Agreement. Finance/legal will compute the exact credit after the impact reconciliation (expected within 2 business days).
3) Remediation: fix for autoscaler race is in review; tentative rollback schedule planned today to harden backoff parameters and improve warmup heuristics.

Links and artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/incident/BL-0909-2027/logs (trace bundle + histograms), sample trace IDs included in the bundle.

If BrightLane needs an immediate temporary remedial action (e.g., routing to dedicated pool) we can open a fast-path and discuss options — just ping me and I'll triage with infra.

—Neha Kapoor
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: elevated errors & latency 09:02–09:28 PDT — next steps and provisional credit

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick follow-up and for sharing the Grafana screenshot. Appreciate your patience while our SREs validated the impact.

Recap & commitments:
- Confirmation: Redwood verified a degraded window overlapping your observed interval. Our server-side window is 09:03:58–09:26:37 PDT.
- Eligibility: Per our initial review this qualifies as an availability incident and is eligible for a prorated SLA credit.
- Evidence bundle: Neha uploaded the traces and latency histograms here: https://drive.redwood.com/incident/BL-0909-2027/logs (attached files: usw2_trace_bundle_09092027.tar.gz, latency_hist_0909.png).
- Postmortem: we'll circulate a draft RCA by EOD 2027-09-10 and a final postmortem (with action items and timeline) within 5 business days.
- Credit calculation & timeline: Finance will compute the prorated credit based on the confirmed window and your usage; I'll share a provisional credit estimate within 48 business hours and a firm credit within 5 business days.

Short-term remediation options: if routing to a dedicated pool or bumping capacity is something BrightLane wants fast-tracked while we complete the RCA, I can set up a technical call with our infra team today — we can also discuss a temporary capacity override to prevent recurrence during the holiday peak.

Please confirm whether you'd like us to open the fast-path for dedicated routing — otherwise we'll proceed with the standard postmortem and credit workflow.

Thanks again — we'll keep this prioritized.

—Elliot

Account Manager, Redwood Inference
